instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md, ANTIGRAVITY_BOOTSTRAP.md and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md from origin/agent-control before doing anything.
Do not use nghoang1288/Prima for any RADAR task, code, receipt, result, artifact or bridge operation.
Verify exact upstream commit 0dbf0ece209b77d722588e5e7943014d3db48f7f exists in alibaba-damo-academy/damo-radar.
Clone/fetch the upstream repository and preserve upstream history, LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and attribution.

Using the bridge bootstrap exception, replace the temporary RADAR-4060 main README baseline exactly once with upstream commit 0dbf0ece209b77d722588e5e7943014d3db48f7f. Record the before/after SHAs in the terminal result.
After the one-time bootstrap replacement, never force-push main again.
Create antigravity/radar-20260922-001 from the exact imported main baseline.
Copy docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md from agent-control into the implementation branch.
Implement an RTX 4060 8GB inference path while preserving the upstream default ROI (96, 256, 384), preprocessing, class order and output semantics.
Keep the full CT and full-volume stitching tensors on CPU; move only the active sliding-window patch to CUDA.
Use torch.inference_mode(), optional FP16 autocast, immediate patch-output transfer back to CPU, and a single-channel overlap count map.
Do not quantize weights or reduce ROI in the reference 4060 path.
Create minimal inference dependencies and WSL helper scripts.
Use only the upstream public demo case for end-to-end testing; do not access local patient data.
Profile baseline and optimized paths with peak allocated/reserved CUDA memory and wall-clock time.
Add synthetic tests for stitching equivalence, count-map broadcasting, AMP-off behavior and CUDA-residency invariants.
Write docs/BENCHMARK.md with exact runtime versions, peak VRAM, runtime and numerical comparison.
If the optimized demo still OOMs, do not hide the failure and do not silently reduce ROI; measure and document the exact blocker.
Push only code, docs, scripts, synthetic tests and aggregate benchmark metrics. Do not push checkpoints or generated clinical outputs.
Open a PR from antigravity/radar-20260922-001 to main. Do not merge it.
Write the terminal result to .antigravity/results/RADAR-20260922-001.json on agent-control.

acceptance: main is replaced exactly once with upstream SHA 0dbf0ece209b77d722588e5e7943014d3db48f7f before implementation changes
agent-control remains separate and contains the RADAR-only task/result protocol
optimized inference preserves the upstream default ROI
full-volume stitching remains CPU-resident in 4060 mode
upstream public demo completes on RTX 4060 8GB without CUDA OOM OR the result documents a precise measured blocker
docs/BENCHMARK.md records exact environment, peak VRAM, runtime and numerical comparison
no patient-derived files or checkpoints are committed
a PR is opened to main but not merged
terminal result is pushed to .antigravity/results/RADAR-20260922-001.json on agent-control
